同位语从句与名词性从句进阶: 分清 that 同位语从句与 that 定语从句,掌握 whether/if、疑问词引导的名词性从句的细节。
同位语从句解释名词内容,that 不作成分、不可省略|定语从句中 that 作成分;同位语从句中 that 不作成分|常见同位语名词:fact, news, idea, belief, suggestion, doubt|主语从句可后置:It is clear that...|whether 引导从句可放句首,if 不行;介词后只用 whether
The news that the flight had been cancelled spread quickly.
column3: 航班取消的消息传得很快。

同位语从句与名词性从句进阶: It remains doubtful whether the funds will arrive on time.
column3: 资金能否按时到位仍有疑问。

同位语从句与名词性从句进阶: Whoever breaks the rule pays the fine.
The suggestion that we postpone the launch was rejected.
column3: 推迟发布的建议被否决了。

同位语从句与名词性从句进阶: That is exactly what the survey revealed.
column3: 那正是调查揭示的结果。

# title: The fact ___ he resigned shocked the whole office.
column4: 同位语从句,that 不作成分也不可省略。

# title: The promise ___ he made last year has been kept.
column4: 定语从句:that 在从句中作 made 的宾语。

# title: ___ the delay was intentional is still unclear.
column4: 句首的主语从句只能用 whether,不能用 if。

# title: It suddenly hit her ___ she had left the keys at the hotel.
column4: It hit her that... 中 that 引导真正的主语从句。

# title: We are debating ___ to invest in new equipment or keep the cash.
column4: whether...or 结构,且介词/不定式前不用 if。

# title: Choose the sentence with an appositive clause (同位语从句).
同位语从句与名词性从句进阶: The belief that patience wins is old but true.|The book that she lent me is due.|The idea that you proposed sounds risky.|The man that called left a number.
column4: 耐心制胜这一信念的内容,that 不作成分,是同位语从句;其余 that 都在从句中作成分。
